ITEM 1 | Dark brown to near-black oval pieces, glossy and slightly wrinkled skin with a smooth sheen, some with lighter tan-brown patches; roughly 2-3 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide, each holding its shape, scattered in a small cluster across the center of a white shallow dish, with a few pieces showing a pale cut or split edge | 90

ITEM 2 | Light to medium brown, matte, slightly wrinkled oval pieces, smaller than the dark ones, about 1.5-2 cm long, intact and firm, a few sitting among the dark pieces in the white dish | 15

ITEM 3 | Small smudge of pale yellowish residue at the left edge of the white dish, thin and flat, no clear shape, possibly a trace of moisture or oil | 1
